question: Using data from both the regular season and the post-season, identify the pitcher who achieved the highest non-zero pitch speed for each team by confirming whether the pitcher’s ID appears in the relevant home or away player lists for that game, then retrieve that pitcher’s full name along with the maximum valid pitch speed they achieved while playing for that specific team.

WITH all_pitches AS (
  SELECT gameId, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName,
         pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed,
         homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,
         homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12,
         awayBatter1, awayBatter2, awayBatter3, awayBatter4, awayBatter5, awayBatter6, awayBatter7, awayBatter8, awayBatter9,
         awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_wide`
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0 AND pitchSpeed <= 110 AND pitcherId IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT gameId, homeTeamId, homeTeamName, awayTeamId, awayTeamName,
         pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, pitchSpeed,
         homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,
         homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12,
         awayBatter1, awayBatter2, awayBatter3, awayBatter4, awayBatter5, awayBatter6, awayBatter7, awayBatter8, awayBatter9,
         awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.baseball.games_post_wide`
  WHERE pitchSpeed > 0 AND pitchSpeed <= 110 AND pitcherId IS NOT NULL
),
pitcher_team AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN pitcherId IN (homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,
                            homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12)
      THEN homeTeamId ELSE awayTeamId END AS pitcherTeamId,
    CASE WHEN pitcherId IN (homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,
                            homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12)
      THEN homeTeamName ELSE awayTeamName END AS pitcherTeamName
  FROM all_pitches
),
pitcher_team_valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM pitcher_team
  WHERE pitcherId IN (homeBatter1, homeBatter2, homeBatter3, homeBatter4, homeBatter5, homeBatter6, homeBatter7, homeBatter8, homeBatter9,
                      homeFielder1, homeFielder2, homeFielder3, homeFielder4, homeFielder5, homeFielder6, homeFielder7, homeFielder8, homeFielder9, homeFielder10, homeFielder11, homeFielder12)
     OR pitcherId IN (awayBatter1, awayBatter2, awayBatter3, awayBatter4, awayBatter5, awayBatter6, awayBatter7, awayBatter8, awayBatter9,
                      awayFielder1, awayFielder2, awayFielder3, awayFielder4, awayFielder5, awayFielder6, awayFielder7, awayFielder8, awayFielder9, awayFielder10, awayFielder11, awayFielder12)
),
max_speeds AS (
  SELECT pitcherTeamId, pitcherTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, MAX(pitchSpeed) as max_speed
  FROM pitcher_team_valid
  GROUP BY pitcherTeamId, pitcherTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT pitcherTeamId, pitcherTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pitcherTeamId ORDER BY max_speed DESC) as rn
  FROM max_speeds
)
SELECT pitcherTeamId, pitcherTeamName, pitcherId, pitcherFirstName, pitcherLastName, max_speed
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY pitcherTeamName
